verdict.rationale: NY DTF's own pages state that businesses can file returns and pay taxes online through a Business Online Services account. They also name specific online filing paths: Corporation Tax Web File for Form CT-5, electronic NYS-1/NYS-45 withholding returns, and Quick Pay bank payments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of completing a filing or payment end-to-end, since the /e-services/ transaction paths were not fetched.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: you can use your Business Online Services account to file and pay New York State taxes
It’s a free, convenient, and secure way to file returns, schedule payments, respond to department notices, and more!
Use Corporation Tax Web File to submit Form CT-5.
File your withholding tax returns (NYS-1 and NYS-45) electronically using your Online Services account
You or your business can use Quick Pay to make a payment toward a bill, notice, or installment payment agreement (IPA) for free directly from your bank account.
